Amius Flips Back to Alternate Form Instantly and Constantly
Problem: Amius HM keeps changing back to alternate form instantly every time he switches back to his original form.

If anyone has any ideas on why Amius is doing this let me know!  I can’t figure it out.  

No champs have Cycle of Magic mastery (cooldown decrease), cooldown reducing artifacts/accessories, and none have any cooldown decreasing skills. I’ve changed out every champ on the team to try and single out if a champ is the issue and it still occurs no matter who is on the team.
